name: Chlordiazepoxide
metabolism: Hepatic metabolism produces active desmethylchlordiazepoxide and demoxepam. Active metabolites persist and can accumulate; urinary elimination includes metabolites and a small unchanged fraction.
summary: Chlordiazepoxide is a benzodiazepine sedative and hypnotic used to treat anxiety, insomnia, and symptoms of withdrawal from alcohol, benzodiazepines, and other drugs.
